purpose: Separate connection-context dependence from missing causal target-device flood statistics; no model repair claim yet
selection: Primary A/B query rows only. Rank SHA256(context-v1|UID), before loading features or scores. A UDP: 32 per device and label; B normal UDP: 8 per device. Edge UDP: 16 normal and 16 attack, same ranking.

ablation.protocol: UDP only; avoids TCP sequence/ack anchor confounding
arms: current-packet E3, direction anchored true + original q14
ablation.single_packet: One burst, one current UDP header, six padding zeros, IAT=0, IP bytes=current IP length, packet count=1, duration=0, direction=true
ablation.controls: Normal UDP from A/B/Edge; already-single-packet rows must be invariant. Baseline replay against saved E3/head decisions.
ablation.model: Same frozen encoder, normalizer, three heads and RAW cuts; C5 distances/support are not recomputed and no modified-input C5 performance is claimed
ablation.report: Paired margins, alarm transitions, E3 changes, header/input uniqueness; per device/class and original packet count. Descriptive fixed slices only.

cross_connection.scope: Edge existing 20000 selected queries in each of NORMAL, HTTP, UDP; scan original three PCAPs on HPC
cross_connection.causality: Same target MAC, logical capture segment, protocol; frame <= query frame and query timestamp-window < event timestamp <= query timestamp, including current packet. No clock sorting in replay; offline exact range algorithm must independently match brute force.
cross_connection.identity: IP addresses/ports/MAC used for grouping and cardinalities only; no literal identifiers, labels, model scores or absolute times enter features
cross_connection.coverage: IPv4 TCP/UDP, unfragmented, complete IP headers and transport ports; record exclusions and assert all selected query protocol/time/owner identities
cross_connection.segments: Frozen five NORMAL segments; no joining. Report all queries and full-window queries separately, protocol matched and inbound-only comparisons, each normal segment separately.
cross_connection.statistics: Report all eight features, fixed high-is-attack AUROC, quantiles and constant fraction. No best-feature selection, training, threshold fitting or IID confidence intervals. AUC is diagnostic separability, not detector recall.
cross_connection.limitations: Edge is now consumed diagnostic data; one device, separate normal/attack captures and normal UDP count 497 limit inference. Capture/session confounding cannot be eliminated. A/B cross-connection raw scans are outside this first diagnostic.

preflight: Same Linux runtime: real raw prefix decoding -> exact cross-connection statistics/brute-force comparison -> original and single-packet encoder/head replay -> saved summary; no distance stage because RAW-only mechanism diagnosis
storage: Raw packets, full feature arrays and detailed paired records stay HPC; retrieve summaries, manifests and acceptance receipts only
decision: A ablation losing margins supports dependence on connection context; strong cross-connection separation motivates a causal aggregate branch, but requires a separately frozen design and future evaluation. Otherwise examine single-packet header domain shift/classifier boundary. Do not force a favorable conclusion.
